events.title: Richard the Lionheart becomes King of England
events.description: Henry II died at Chinon, and his son Richard succeeded him. Famed as a crusader against Saladin, Richard spent barely six months of his ten-year reign in England.
events.html: Henry II died at Chinon, and his son Richard succeeded him. Famed as a crusader against Saladin, Richard spent barely six months of his ten-year reign in England.

events.title: Jan Hus is burned at the stake in Constance
events.description: The Czech reformer Jan Hus, condemned as a heretic by the Council of Constance despite a promise of safe conduct, was burned. His death provoked the Hussite revolt in Bohemia a century before Luther.
events.html: The Czech reformer Jan Hus, condemned as a heretic by the Council of Constance despite a promise of safe conduct, was burned. His death provoked the Hussite revolt in Bohemia a century before Luther.

events.title: Richard III is crowned at Westminster Abbey
events.description: Richard, Duke of Gloucester, was crowned after his nephew Edward V was declared illegitimate. Two years later his death at Bosworth ended Plantagenet rule and brought the Tudors to the throne.
events.html: Richard, Duke of Gloucester, was crowned after his nephew Edward V was declared illegitimate. Two years later his death at Bosworth ended Plantagenet rule and brought the Tudors to the throne.

events.title: Monmouth's rebellion is crushed at Sedgemoor
events.description: Royal troops routed the Duke of Monmouth's rebel army at Sedgemoor in Somerset, often called the last pitched battle on English soil. Judge Jeffreys's 'Bloody Assizes' followed.
events.html: Royal troops routed the Duke of Monmouth's rebel army at Sedgemoor in Somerset, often called the last pitched battle on English soil. Judge Jeffreys's 'Bloody Assizes' followed.

events.title: German ambassador Mirbach is assassinated in Moscow
events.description: Left Socialist Revolutionaries shot Count Wilhelm von Mirbach in the German embassy, hoping to wreck the Brest-Litovsk peace. Their uprising was crushed and the Bolsheviks became Russia's sole ruling party.
events.html: Left Socialist Revolutionaries shot Count Wilhelm von Mirbach in the German embassy, hoping to wreck the Brest-Litovsk peace. Their uprising was crushed and the Bolsheviks became Russia's sole ruling party.

events.title: Fire sweeps a circus big top in Hartford, killing 167
events.description: The Ringling Bros. tent, waterproofed with paraffin and petrol, caught fire during a matinee in Hartford, Connecticut. At least 167 people died, many of them children, prompting tighter fire-safety rules.
